# BoardKit

> A Progressive Web App that generates structured GitHub project boards
> from pre-built templates - 20+ templates and 900+ pre-written issues,
> cutting hours of manual setup down to seconds.

BoardKit connects to GitHub via OAuth and generates a complete project
board - issues, labels, and phases - from a chosen template in one click.
Templates can also be created from scratch or imported from CSV/JSON.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://boardkit.app/): Template gallery and one-click board
  generation.
- [Create a template](https://boardkit.app/templates/create): Build a
  custom template from scratch.
- [Import a template](https://boardkit.app/templates/import): Import a
  template from CSV or JSON.
- [Privacy](https://boardkit.app/privacy): Data usage and privacy policy.

## Technical implementation

- **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Auth:** GitHub OAuth (NextAuth.js)
- **GitHub API:** Octokit.js
- **PWA:** Installable on mobile devices

Source and full documentation: https://github.com/Younique98/boardkit
